class.name: aidin_hand2_controllers/JointPositionController
class.description: Chainable controller commanding the active joint target in rad.

class.name: aidin_hand2_controllers/ActuatorPositionController
class.description: Chainable controller commanding the actuator position in encoder counts, a raw interface.

class.name: aidin_hand2_controllers/ActuatorEffortController
class.description: Chainable controller commanding the actuator effort in rated current percent, a raw interface.

class.name: aidin_hand2_controllers/JointImpedanceController
class.description: Chainable controller commanding the joint equilibrium target in rad, the gains being tuned on the hardware node.

class.name: aidin_hand2_controllers/HandStateBroadcaster
class.description: Broadcasts the observation snapshot of joint, actuator and tactile state on ~/hand_state.

class.name: aidin_hand2_controllers/DiagnosticsBroadcaster
class.description: Broadcasts lifecycle, homing, timing counters and per-actuator health on ~/hand_diagnostics.
